facts.notes: The script makes only claims demonstrated by the local review gate.

structure.notes: Problem, review gates, stop condition, pass path, and result are explicit.

duration.notes: Eight concise slides target a 20–30 second short on the demo-quality voice path.

visual_feasibility.notes: Every slide uses an existing composition and canonical design tokens.

hierarchy.notes: Each slide has one obvious primary message and no competing focal point.

simplicity.notes: No decorative element is required to understand the demo.

clarity.notes: Type scale, spacing, labels, and contrast communicate the intended reading order.

legibility.notes: The planned text volume fits the supported mobile-first compositions without relying on desktop-scale viewing.

craft.notes: The script stays within the existing component, spacing, type, color, and motion system.

privacy.notes: No personal data, local paths, credentials, account identifiers, or private assets.

copyright.notes: Repository-owned copy and generated text-only visuals; no third-party media.
